title: Clinical feature-related single-base substitution sequence signatures identified with an unsupervised machine learning approach
summary: LSTM-SOM clustering of TCGA mutations using flanking sequence features yielded ten mutation classes associated with pathology and patient clinical/survival groupings; these are computational associations, not causal mechanisms.
